intro: Sweetgreen is a fast-casual chain built around salads, warm grain bowls and protein plates made with fresh, seasonal ingredients. You can order a signature salad or bowl, build your own, or pick a protein plate. The menu changes with the seasons, so some items come and go. Below is the Sweetgreen menu with prices for 2026.
quick_answer: Most Sweetgreen signature salads and warm bowls run about $9.75 to $12.75, with protein plates around $11 to $13 and seasonal items in the same range. A build-your-own salad or bowl is priced by what you add. Sides are about $2 to $5, and shareable family-size bowls are around $29 to $39.
hot_deal: Sweetgreen Rewards and seasonal menus: Sweetgreen runs an app rewards program and launches new seasonal salads and bowls through the year. It also posts full nutrition for every item. Offers and menu items vary by season and location, so check the Sweetgreen app.

faqs.q: How much is a salad at Sweetgreen?
faqs.a: Most Sweetgreen signature salads run about $9.75 to $12, with warm bowls and protein plates around $10 to $13. Build-your-own salads are priced by what you add. Prices vary by location and season.

faqs.q: What is the Harvest Bowl at Sweetgreen?
faqs.a: The Harvest Bowl is one of Sweetgreen's most popular warm bowls, made with chicken, wild rice, roasted sweet potatoes, apples, goat cheese and almonds, usually around $10.75.
Yes. Sweetgreen rotates its menu with the seasons, adding limited-time salads and bowls and retiring others, so some items come and go through the year.

faqs.q: Can you build your own salad at Sweetgreen?
faqs.a: Yes. You can create your own salad or warm bowl by choosing a base, toppings, a protein and a dressing. The price depends on what you add, especially premium proteins.
Yes. Sweetgreen posts full nutrition for its menu, including calories. Because many bowls are seasonal or built to order, the exact calories depend on the item and your build.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at Sweetgreen?
faqs.a: Fan favorites include the Harvest Bowl, Kale Caesar, Guacamole Greens, Chicken Pesto Parm and the Shroomami bowl.
